title: Map the platform: control plane, compute, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog
objective_text: Explain where the control plane and compute run, what makes a table Delta, and how Unity Catalog names and manages tables.
scenario: A security reviewer at a bank asks a new data engineer where Databricks runs each part of the platform, what format the team's tables are in, and who owns the files when a governed table is dropped.
verifies: You can pick the right component, method or trigger for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can do it in Databricks: nothing is set up or run here. Reading a real table's log and history is exercise E02.

validation.fail: Not all right yet: reread the lesson's notes and try again.

explanation: Each question's answer, reason and source page are shown after a pass or on request.
review_notes: Every claim was checked against its source page on 2026-11-09.
